messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: New MS version of RevoMath-3.2.3.exe doesn't install MKL properly
parts:
Perhaps another installation of MKL exists on your system. 


What is the install path to your 3.2.3 version of the MKL?  

Have you installed MKL before?  

Did you also install it into the default location AND in C:\Gnu\RRO\library?


Thanks

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: New MS version of RevoMath-3.2.3.exe doesn't install MKL properly
parts:
Hi, John

Thank you for trying MRO with the MKL!

I also encountered this error last week, and despite several uninstall and reinstall cycles, the problem didn't go away.

Eventually, I realised that I had used different install paths for different installs of MRO.  Concretely, I first installed in c:\MRO\... and then in c:\program files\...\MRO\...

Although I uninstalled both MRO and the MKL, I realised that there were some remnants of old files in the old installation directory.

So, I manually deleted these remnants, i.e. I manually deleted the files in both locations.

Then I installed MRO followed by MKL. Since then everything has been working smoothly.

My hunch is that the new MKL installer leaves some traces behind upon uninstall.  I will ask the team to take a look at this.

I hope it works for you!

Andrie
